title: Massachusetts's 2nd Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Massachusetts's 2nd Congressional District will be held on November 3, 2026. The district encompasses central Massachusetts including Worcester, Northampton, and surrounding communities. Incumbent Democrat Jim McGovern, first elected in 1996 and the ranking member of the House Rules Committee, is seeking re-election. No Republican candidates filed for the primary ballot, and the race is rated 'Solid D' by nonpartisan forecasters, reflecting the district's heavily Democratic lean (D+13 Cook PVI).
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The district is considered safely Democratic by all major nonpartisan forecasters (Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, Sabato's Crystal Ball).

candidates.name: James P. McGovern
candidates.summary: Jim McGovern has represented Massachusetts's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 1997. He serves as the ranking member of the House Rules Committee and is a progressive stalwart known for his work on anti-poverty initiatives, food security, and campaign finance reform. McGovern announced his re-election campaign in May 2026, stating he remains energized to fight for his constituents in Worcester and central Massachusetts.

summary_sources.title: McGovern announces run for another term in Congress
